reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper the UI, schedules app and preview code already use for the expected amount.

duplication.why: No range or null logic is copied; the one-line field delegates entirely to the helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is built.

scope.why: Only the type, the mapping line, a focused test file and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule flows to the API automatically through the shared helper.
